responsibility: This source file contains option-processing code shared between the driver and compiler proper, centered on decoding, classifying, and replaying command-line options from GCC’s generated cl_options tables. It implements the core option lookup algorithm with back-chaining and long-option abbreviation handling, warning/alias/control-option processing, parsing of COLLECT_GCC_OPTIONS-style quoted option strings, and the jobserver_info runtime support for GNU make jobserver discovery and token exchange, making it the common low-level engine beneath higher-level option handlers.
